rows.reasoning: As Speaker he voted Y on AB 103 (2025), a single-subject bill providing that school staff may not use a name or pronouns not aligned with a minor's biological sex "without written authorization from the pupil’s parent or legal guardian", which matches the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns." His Y votes on the multi-subject parental-rights bills AB 510 and AB 963 point the same way but cannot carry a chair alone.
